'''Security droids''' were used by the war-profiteer [[Attuma Duum]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], along with the rogue [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] [[Shon-Ju]], attacked Duum and destroyed several of these droids.

==Characteristics==
These [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] were tall, bipedal [[Droid/Legends|units]]. The droids had two arms; the left one consisted of several [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] while the right one consisted of a claw. These droids had a flexible torso, and the head had a primitive [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] and a square video screen. They were primarily gray, although one was white with red trim.

==History==
The war-profiteer [[Attuma Duum]] used at least four of these droids in his [[Attuma Duum's headquarters|hidden]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid base]]. One of them accompanied Duum's chief of security [[Sabat (mercenary)|Sabat]] to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Cavamina Minor]] to hunt the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] after Secura crashed her [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighter]]. While fleeing Sabat's armed gang, Secura was rescued by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Shon-Ju]]. Shon-Ju confronted Sabat, and attacked Sabat's men when the latter refused to back down. Jumping over Sabat, Shon-Ju channeled [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] through his hands to dismantle the droid. Fearing for his life, Sabat escaped.

Secura collapsed from her injuries, and she was taken to [[Shon-Ju's castle]] to recover. After she woke, she recruited Shon-Ju's help in arresting Duum. The next morning, they stole two of [[Unidentified bomber|Sabat's abandoned ships]] and infiltrated Duum's base. Shon-Ju deliberately tripped the alarm to be captured and brought to Duum. The alarm alerted Duum's security force to their presences; armed guards and one of these droids. Secura [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-pushed]] the guards and used her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to destroy the droid. Sabat took Shon-Ju hostage and Secura surrendered. The two Force-sensitives were put in bonds, and two droids were stationed nearby. Shon-Ju used his Force-powers to break free and destroy the droids. He then went off to kill Duum. Secura also broke free to stop Shon-Ju, allowing Duum to escape.

==Behind the scenes==
These droids appear in the [[2010]] graphic novella ''[[The Clone Wars: Deadly Hands of Shon-Ju]]''.
